notes: SBP EasyData API, As-Needed series (a row only when a rate changes). Re-queryable, but SBP may revise or remove data without notice, so each run's raw responses are kept as the record of what we saw (append_only_snapshot); revisions against the previous run are logged as warnings. Long format, one row per series per observation; the three series are never merged. To get the policy rate on day d: take the series whose policy window contains d (Reverse Repo 2009-08-17..2015-05-24, Target Rate from 2015-05-25), then its latest row with observation_date <= d. effective_to is the next observation date of the same series (exclusive). published_at is null (basis 'unknown'): the API has no publication date; announcement dates will come from a separate MPC calendar dataset. Do not back-fill before a series' first observation.
